title: An exponent-$s$ dynamical Borel-Cantelli lemma and the waiting time problem
summary: Galatolo and Kim proved that the dynamical Borel-Cantelli property for decreasing sequences of balls is tightly connected with the waiting time problem. In systems where all such sequences are Borel-Cantelli, the time needed to enter a small ball $B$ for the first time scales as $μ(B)^{-1}$, and conversely, waiting time estimates yield Borel-Cantelli results for sequences of balls whose radii decrease in a controlled way.
